name: chess-bench-npy
description: A dataset of chess positions stored as NumPy arrays intended for benchmarking move-prediction and position-evaluation models. It is designed for supervised training and evaluation of models that predict the best move(s) from a given board state and to measure model accuracy in selecting engine-recommended or human-annotated moves. Typical uses include top-k move prediction and move ranking experiments.
reputation: A small, specialized dataset on Hugging Face for ML-based chess research and model evaluation; modest adoption within the niche community.
